_about: Working stage scenario, still subject to site-plan and product changes; do not build logic or default copy around its details. This seeded MOCK/DEMO_MODE run uses fictional organiser names, contact details, suppliers and arrangements for demonstration only. It is not an actual application or evidence that a special licence has been granted. Every key is validated by tests/contract.test.ts. Council rules and checklists for live events come from verified knowledge, not this fixture.
description: Fundraiser for Riccarton Rugby Club at Hagley Park on Sunday 14 March, 12 till 7pm. Around 400 people, families and kids welcome. Beer will be sold from a beer tent for adults, three food trucks, a bouncy castle and a DJ. We will need a couple of marquees.

questions.question: How big is your largest marquee?

classification.reasoning: The council source lists community and commercial fee bands for Hagley Park but does not define which applies here. A club fundraiser alone does not establish the organiser's legal status, use of proceeds, or council classification.
classification.howToPresent: Explain who runs the event, where proceeds go, and any commercial activity; ask the council to confirm the category before quoting a fee.

sections.heading: Event overview
sections.body: DEMO ONLY. Riccarton RFC Fundraiser is a proposed family event at Hagley Park on Sunday 14 March 2027, 12pm to 7pm, with an expected peak of 400 people including children. Beer sales are planned for an adults-only tent, subject to a special licence being granted.

sections.heading: Key hazards and controls
sections.body: Inflatable bouncy castle, anchored to manufacturer specification and supervised by Sam Example (fictional demo volunteer). Generator for food trucks, fenced and away from public areas. If licensed, alcohol sales will be confined to the designated tent with a duty manager present.

sections.heading: Emergency response
sections.body: First aid beside the main entrance. In an evacuation, marshals direct attendees through the north and east exits to [ASSEMBLY POINT].

sections.heading: Roles and contacts
sections.body: Event manager Alex Example; proposed duty manager Taylor Example; first aid provider Demo First Aid Crew. All are fictional demo assignments to verify before lodging.

sections.heading: Bins and recycling
sections.body: Rubbish and recycling bins at the beer tent, beside each of the three food trucks and at both entrances.

sections.heading: During and after the event
sections.body: Volunteers empty bins during the event and walk the site for litter after close at 7pm. Demo Waste Services (fictional demo contractor) is assigned to remove the waste that evening.

sections.heading: Inflatable bouncy castle
sections.body: Risk: falls, collisions and the castle lifting in wind. Proposed controls: anchored to manufacturer specification, supervised by Sam Example (fictional demo volunteer), age and number limits posted, deflated if the wind picks up. Residual risk: to be confirmed on site.

sections.heading: Generator and food truck cooking
sections.body: Risk: burns, fire and fuel spills. Controls: generator fenced off from the public, fire extinguisher at each food truck, gas bottles secured upright. Residual risk: low.

sections.heading: Alcohol
sections.body: Risk: intoxication and under-18s being served. If a special licence is granted, proposed controls are sales only inside the fenced beer tent, duty manager Taylor Example (fictional demo assignment) on site, and ID checks at the entrance. Residual risk: to be confirmed on site.

sections.heading: Crowd and lost children
sections.body: Risk: crowding at the busiest time (about 400 people) and children getting separated. Controls: marshals at both entrances, lost child point at the first aid tent. Residual risk: low.

sections.heading: Type of event
sections.body: DEMO ONLY. Proposed family fundraiser, about 400 people at peak including children. Beer sales in a fenced adults-only tent are planned only if a special licence is granted. Event manager Alex Example is in charge overall; proposed duty manager Taylor Example is in charge of the tent. Both are fictional demo assignments.

sections.heading: Promoting your event
sections.body: Promotion states the event is family-focused, that intoxicated people will be refused service and removed, that no alcohol may be brought in, and that ID is checked at the beer tent.

sections.heading: Intoxication
sections.body: If licensed, bar staff and the duty manager will monitor patrons and intervene early. Intoxicated people will be refused entry. The fictional demo welfare point is a quiet tent beside first aid.

sections.heading: Food
sections.body: Three food trucks are planned to trade throughout alcohol sales. Alex Example (fictional demo manager) will check that food stays available; if it runs out, alcohol sales stop.

sections.heading: Low and non-alcohol beverages
sections.body: Low-alcohol beer, soft drinks and free water are available and promoted at the beer tent at all times.

sections.heading: Minors
sections.body: Photo ID (NZ driver licence, passport or 18+ card) is checked for anyone who appears under 25.

sections.heading: Signage
sections.body: If granted, the special licence will be displayed at the beer tent with required signage at each point of sale. Alex Example (fictional demo manager) will put up the signs.

sections.heading: Safe transport
sections.body: The fictional demo plan marks a taxi pickup at the park edge and gives public-transport information at the tent exit. Staff will offer alternatives to anyone who has been drinking and intends to drive.

sections.heading: Alcohol promotions on the day
sections.body: No discounts, drinking games or alcohol prizes.

sections.heading: Staff training
sections.body: All bar staff and volunteers are briefed on the licence conditions and this plan before the event.

sections.heading: Incident and noting book
sections.body: The duty manager records refusals, removals and incidents in an incident book kept at the tent.

sections.heading: Security
sections.body: The fictional demo plan assigns two staff from Demo Event Security, 11am to 8pm, with Alex Example as liaison. A real provider, staffing level and qualifications must be confirmed before lodging.

sections.heading: Environment
sections.body: Seating and shade around the tent, a family focus, and toilets available throughout.

sections.heading: Debriefing
sections.body: Staff and contractors debrief after the event to note improvements.

deadlines.label: Lodge event permit application with site plan and health and safety plan
deadlines.basis: CCC processing starts at five weeks for a low impact event. We aim for ten weeks.

deadlines.label: Lodge special licence application
deadlines.basis: At least 20 working days before the event. 20 Dec to 15 Jan does not count. We aim two weeks earlier.

deadlines.label: Attach alcohol management plan to special licence application
deadlines.basis: The alcohol management plan is an attachment to the special licence application, so it shares that lodgement date.

deadlines.label: Provide site plan to CCC
deadlines.basis: CCC's conditions for events on public land require this plan at least six weeks before the event.
